r1:
Based on the available NYSC documents:

The exact amount can change by government directive, so corps members should confirm the current amount from NYSC official announcements, the NYSC portal, or the state secretariat. The available NYSC documents mention N77,000 per month from March 2025, but the current rate for a later batch should always be confirmed officially. Allowance is usually paid into the bank account linked to the corps member's NYSC records. Camp account opening or bank details may be handled during camp or through NYSC instructions. If your account details are wrong, follow NYSC procedure to correct them.

Sources:
1. NYSC Allowance and Payment Guide - https://www.nysc.gov.ng

Caution: Please confirm critical issues with the official NYSC portal or your state secretariat.
r2:
Based on the available NYSC documents:

The NYSC call-up letter is the document that tells a prospective corps member the state of deployment, orientation camp address, reporting date, call-up number, batch and stream, and important camp instructions. You print the call-up letter from your NYSC portal dashboard after deployment is released. Log in with your registered email and password, open the relevant call-up letter option, download or print it, and keep copies for camp registration.

Sources:
1. NYSC Call-up Letter and Posting Guide - https://portal.nysc.org.ng
